patterns.note: The 'OUR PLAYBOOK' section uses an asymmetrical two-column layout, featuring large numbered headings and descriptive text on the left, paired with a stack of smaller, related images on the right.

Extremely bold, uppercase, and condensed sans-serif typography is used for primary branding and large section numbers, creating a strong visual hierarchy and impact, contrasting with a more standard sans-serif for body text.
A high-contrast color scheme of dominant red, black, and off-white is used in large, full-bleed blocks to define distinct sections and create a striking visual identity.
Content sections, particularly the numbered 'OUR PLAYBOOK' items, are revealed sequentially with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as the user scrolls down the page, guiding the narrative flow.
Sections are clearly delineated by full-width background color changes (e.g., red hero, black intro, off-white content) and introduced by prominent, often numbered, display typography.

technique_notes: The initial full-screen hero, featuring a bold logo and tagline on a vibrant background, scrolls up and out of view to reveal the main content sections below.

Content blocks and associated imagery are revealed progressively as the user scrolls, utilizing scroll-triggered CSS keyframes to animate elements with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and guided content experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, uppercase display headings (~6-8x body text) for maximum impact, with body text being a standard, legible size.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners universally, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy and spacious, particularly in the 'OUR PLAYBOOK' section, creating a sense of importance and focus for each item, while project grids are more balanced.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of a high-contrast red and black palette combined with extremely bold, oversized typography for branding and key section markers. The sequential, scroll-triggered reveal of content, particularly the numbered 'OUR PLAYBOOK' items, creates a unique narrative flow that feels both structured and dynamic, avoiding a typical static content presentation.
